surf_linux_capture.scope: Loopback encrypted UDP regression suite; not a native browser application-session reference.

limits: Native browsers retain certificate verification and reject the controlled alternate peer certificate after their Initial/HRR exchange. Native accepted application-session parity is not established.
Chromium references are www.google.com background connections from an official x64 snapshot under emulation. Firefox executes natively on Linux arm64.
Socket payloads preserve exact UDP segmentation. Wireshark analysis envelopes are synthetic and establish neither OS packet layout nor timing parity.
Handshake/Application-space PTO behavior, undecryptable peer hints and full congestion/timing parity remain separate work.
Native byte vectors include no TLS PSK ticket identities; raw captures, profiles and key logs are excluded from the repository.
